name: Hirosaki Kanade
source:
Kanade is the little sister of Tomoki’s friend Hiroki and also another childhood friend of Tomoki. She is a year younger than [url=/c2641]Yuuhi[/url] and Tomoki though. 

She is a very shy girl who gets embarrassed easily and relies on her best friend Natsuki to talk for her a lot, but is also bullied a lot because of her personality. She also enjoys reading.

[Edited and taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/12/14/your-diary-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
